api/src/services/docs_indexer.py.name: Documentation search index
api/src/services/docs_indexer.py.description: Loads Bifrost's own help pages into search so assistants can answer questions about the platform.

api/src/services/embeddings/__init__.py.name: Meaning-based search
api/src/services/embeddings/__init__.py.description: Gives the platform one shared way to turn text into patterns that let search match on meaning.

api/src/services/embeddings/base.py.name: Search provider groundwork
api/src/services/embeddings/base.py.description: Sets the shared settings and rules that every meaning-based search provider must follow.

api/src/services/embeddings/factory.py.name: Search provider choice
api/src/services/embeddings/factory.py.description: Picks which provider turns text into search patterns, based on the AI settings the platform saved.

api/src/services/embeddings/openai_clien.name: OpenAI meaning search
api/src/services/embeddings/openai_clien.description: Asks OpenAI to turn text into searchable patterns so documents can be found by meaning, not just words.

api/src/services/embeddings/reindex.py.name: Search rebuild
api/src/services/embeddings/reindex.py.description: Rebuilds the search patterns for stored knowledge after the AI provider or model changes, and can be stopped.

api/src/services/embeddings/url_safety.p.name: Provider address checks
api/src/services/embeddings/url_safety.p.description: Blocks unsafe web addresses from being used as a search provider so the server cannot reach internal systems.

api/src/services/knowledge/__init__.py.name: Knowledge search helpers
api/src/services/knowledge/__init__.py.description: Groups the helpers that prepare documents and answers for meaning-based search.

api/src/services/knowledge/chunking.py.name: Document splitting
api/src/services/knowledge/chunking.py.description: Cuts long text into overlapping pieces so search can find and quote the right passage.

api/src/services/knowledge/search_budget.name: Search limits for assistants
api/src/services/knowledge/search_budget.description: Caps how much an assistant may search and read in one turn, and drops repeated results.

api/src/services/llms_txt.py.name: Assistant guide file
api/src/services/llms_txt.py.description: Writes the plain-text guide that tells outside AI assistants what Bifrost can do and how to call it.

api/src/services/source_search/__init__..name: Source code search
api/src/services/source_search/__init__..description: Searches workspace and installed solution files by text or pattern and returns matches page by page.

api/src/services/source_search/candidate.name: Result paging
api/src/services/source_search/candidate.description: Walks the files a search should look at in a steady order so results arrive a page at a time.

api/src/services/source_search/cursor.py.name: Page position tokens
api/src/services/source_search/cursor.py.description: Remembers exactly where a search stopped so the next page continues correctly even as files change.

api/src/services/source_search/guidance..name: Search next-step hint
api/src/services/source_search/guidance..description: Tells the caller in plain words what the results mean and how to see more.

api/src/services/source_search/matching..name: Line matching
api/src/services/source_search/matching..description: Finds matching lines inside a file, keeps very long lines readable and stops runaway patterns.
